analysis: Validation-set confidence sweep used to pick the commit_confidence_threshold
rationale: Confidence is only moderately separable between correct and incorrect predictions for this RBF SVC (median confidence for incorrect predictions is still high). 0.75 discarded ~12% of validation frames including many correct ones (e.g. the documented letter I sample at 0.4496 confidence). 0.50 keeps 94.0% of frames while raising kept-frame accuracy from 88.1% (no gate) to 92.2%, and stays within the 0.50-0.55 range suggested for the commit threshold. It is used only to gate whether a frame counts toward the temporal-stability window; the raw/display prediction is shown to the user regardless of confidence.
